info.title: R2PL Game Partner Integration
info.description: Integration contract for the student race portal backend. Portal verifies student/staff identity and provides accepted campaign distance from vRace. Game converts distance to running points, owns the spendable wallet and issues browser-bound launch tickets. Only partner endpoints and service discovery are included here; game browser sessions and editor APIs are managed by Game. HMAC-SHA256 signs seven UTF-8 lines joined with LF and no trailing LF: r2pl-v1, campaignId, POST, exact path, timestamp milliseconds, nonce, lowercase SHA256(raw JSON body bytes). Clock skew <=300 seconds; fresh nonce/signature per attempt. Retry with the identical running snapshot; use accounts to reconcile if a previously unaccepted snapshot becomes stale. Maximum JSON body 16384 bytes; 300 authenticated requests/minute/key/campaign. Separate credentials for Sandbox and Production. See PARTNER_API_HANDOFF.md in the handoff package.

servers.description: Main game (Production) — awaiting partner Portal API integration; separate campaign and credentials
Demo (Sandbox) — simulated identity and running data from https://portal.skai0o0.id.vn/

post.summary: Provision verified student/staff or suspend access
post.description: Only the signed portal backend calls this after verified identity and campaign eligibility checks. Competitive students use the eight existing IDs and receive role=user/playable=true. Company staff use schoolId=amtech plus email/emailVerified=true; approved exact emails override schoolId. Verified staff resolve to organizationId=amtech, schoolId=null, role=admin, playable=false. AMTECH has no competitive slot, HQ, wallet, running conversion, or ranking. Staff launch into the Game admin dashboard; Game-managed permissions determine available tools. Verified amtech.vn/amtech-vn.com default to full access; acer.com/dava.vn default to rankings-only access. Self-service school selection must never provision staff. externalStudentId is a stable opaque portal ID, never an email. schoolId is mapped from the portal school registry, never guessed from an email suffix. Repeated requests do not reset a wallet. Competitive school change returns 409. Upgrading a verified staff identity revokes existing player sessions and running bindings while preserving historical wallets; it never grants a new wallet. active=false invalidates sessions/tickets; open sockets are checked every 5 seconds and before commands. Initial Points/Crystals/Keys are zero.

post.summary: Reconcile accepted campaign distance into the game wallet
post.description: revision increases per student per campaign. Payload is a cumulative campaign snapshot, not an activity delta and not all-time vRace distance. observedAtMs is when the portal took the snapshot, within 5 minutes of game server time. Reuse identical observedAtMs and weekly values on retries. Same revision/same payload returns original receipt with replay=true; different payload returns 409. A newer revision can correct accepted distance: debit the difference if spendable balance permits, otherwise 409 CORRECTION_REQUIRES_REVIEW with NO mutation. No silent clamp or overwrite of a spent wallet. Convert floor(cumulativeMeters*10/1000) under ruleVersion 1; fractional distances accumulate before rounding. Weekly meters use Monday 00:00 UTC+7. Weekly reset requires a new revision. The response balance is at commit time; query accounts for current balance. Business receipts persist across restarts.

post.summary: Read one student's earned running score and current spendable wallet
post.description: Private server-to-server result. Portal may use earnedRunningPoints on the race leaderboard and spendablePoints as the remaining game budget. Rewards in the game affect spendablePoints only. No public email or cross-student wallet endpoint.

post.summary: Issue one-use browser-bound game login ticket
post.description: Start at game origin. The configured Portal login URL must use HTTPS with no pre-existing query string or fragment; Game adds the handoff parameters. Game generates a verifier in tab sessionStorage, sends its S256 challenge to PORTAL_LOGIN_URL using game_campaign, game_challenge, game_return query parameters. Portal authenticates its current student, verifies exact registered game_return, then calls this endpoint with that student and challenge. Redirect same browser tab using HTTP 303 to the returned launchUrl. Do not put tokens in query strings or iframe postMessage. Ticket lasts 60 seconds; stored hashed; consumed once. This custom partner handoff is not an OAuth implementation.

200.description: Game and its database are available

mode.description: Sandbox uses staging; Production uses production.

Campaign.name: X-R2PL-Campaign
Campaign.description: Assigned campaign UUID, part of signed message

Timestamp.name: X-R2PL-Timestamp
Timestamp.description: Unix milliseconds as a 13-digit decimal string

Nonce.name: X-R2PL-Nonce
Nonce.description: 16–128 base64url characters; new cryptographically random value for every request

Signature.name: X-R2PL-Signature
Signature.description: Lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 signature of canonical message described above

Error.description: 400 invalid JSON/body/time; 401 missing/invalid signature; 403 suspended/origin rejected, ADMIN_CANNOT_PLAY, VERIFIED_ADMIN_IDENTITY_REQUIRED; 404 unknown member/route; 405 method; 409 REQUEST_REPLAY, REVISION_CONFLICT, STALE_REVISION, CORRECTION_REQUIRES_REVIEW, SCHOOL_CHANGE_REQUIRES_REVIEW, CONVERSION_CHANGE_REQUIRES_REVIEW, IDENTITY_ALREADY_BOUND; 413 size; 415 media type; 429 rate (Retry-After: 60); 503 transient. Retry 429/503/network errors with bounded exponential backoff, new auth headers, unchanged business snapshot. Do not automatically retry other 4xx. Request ID is safe to include in support requests; never send secrets/tokens.

Decimal.description: Canonical unsigned decimal string; wire strings prevent JSON precision loss. revision <= PostgreSQL bigint max; cumulative meters <= JS safe integer.

RunningRevision.description: Positive decimal string, starting at 1 and increasing per student per campaign; maximum 9223372036854775807. An account with no running snapshot reports revision 0.

eduVerified.description: Must be true for competitive student membership. Not required for verified company staff.

email.description: Email verified by the signed Portal backend, never a browser assertion. Required for staff provisioning.

emailVerified.description: Must be true for staff. Exact approved staff emails override schoolId; verified amtech.vn/amtech-vn.com/acer.com/dava.vn domains also resolve to admin. Acer/Dava default to rankings-only access; Game manages granular permissions.

weekStartMs.description: Monday 00:00 Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh for observedAtMs; weeklyMeters cannot exceed cumulativeMeters
